verdict.rationale: The cyber-security page confirms the firm advises clients to anticipate, respond to, and recover from cyber incidents, covering breach response generally, but there is no specific documentation of regulator-facing incident-response work (e.g., notifying data protection authorities, ICO engagement) or dedicated breach-response case studies. Missing for 10: explicit mention of regulator notification/liaison work, breach-response case studies or outcomes, and detail on incident-response team structure or methodology.
